happy_path.title: Successful login with valid credentials
happy_path.expected: User is redirected to /dashboard and session is created

happy_path.title: Successful login with special characters in password
steps: Enter valid password with special characters (e.g., P@ssw0rd!)
happy_path.expected: User is redirected to /dashboard and session is created

happy_path.title: Successful login with long password
happy_path.expected: User is redirected to /dashboard and session is created

edge_cases.title: Login with minimum length password (8 characters)
steps: Enter password with exactly 8 characters (e.g., Pass1234)
edge_cases.expected: Password is accepted and login proceeds if email and password are correct

edge_cases.title: Login with email containing subdomain
edge_cases.expected: Email is accepted as valid format and login proceeds

edge_cases.title: Login with email containing plus addressing
steps: Enter email with plus addressing (e.g., user+tag@example.com)
edge_cases.expected: Email is accepted as valid format and login proceeds

edge_cases.title: Login with uppercase letters in email
edge_cases.expected: Email is accepted (case-insensitive) and login proceeds

edge_cases.title: Account lock after exactly 5 failed attempts
steps: Enter invalid password and click Login
Repeat step 3 four more times (total 5 attempts)
Attempt login again with correct password
edge_cases.expected: After 5th failed attempt, account is locked. 6th attempt shows account locked message

edge_cases.title: Account unlock after 15 minutes of lock
steps: Lock account by failing 5 login attempts
edge_cases.expected: Account is unlocked and user can log in successfully

edge_cases.title: Login attempt after 14 minutes of lock
steps: Lock account by failing 5 login attempts
edge_cases.expected: Account is still locked and login attempt fails

edge_cases.title: Email with international domain
steps: Enter email with international domain (e.g., user@example.co.uk)
edge_cases.expected: Email is accepted as valid format and login proceeds

negative_cases.title: Login with invalid email format - missing @
negative_cases.expected: Generic error message displayed: 'Invalid email or password' without field specification

negative_cases.title: Login with invalid email format - missing domain
negative_cases.expected: Generic error message displayed: 'Invalid email or password' without field specification

negative_cases.title: Login with password less than 8 characters
negative_cases.expected: Generic error message displayed: 'Invalid email or password' without field specification

negative_cases.title: Login with empty email field
negative_cases.expected: Generic error message displayed: 'Invalid email or password' without field specification

negative_cases.title: Login with empty password field
negative_cases.expected: Generic error message displayed: 'Invalid email or password' without field specification

negative_cases.title: Login with both fields empty
steps: Leave both email and password fields empty
negative_cases.expected: Generic error message displayed: 'Invalid email or password' without field specification

negative_cases.title: Login with correct email but wrong password
negative_cases.expected: Generic error message displayed: 'Invalid email or password' without revealing email exists

negative_cases.title: Login with unregistered email and valid password format
negative_cases.expected: Generic error message displayed: 'Invalid email or password' without revealing email doesn't exist

negative_cases.title: Login with SQL injection attempt in email
steps: Enter SQL injection payload in email (e.g., admin'--)
negative_cases.expected: Login fails with generic error message. No SQL injection executed

negative_cases.title: Login with XSS attempt in password
negative_cases.expected: Login fails with generic error message. No script is executed

negative_cases.title: Account locked message does not reveal lock duration
steps: Lock account by failing 5 login attempts
negative_cases.expected: Account locked message is displayed without revealing exact unlock time

negative_cases.title: Login with spaces in email
negative_cases.expected: Generic error message displayed: 'Invalid email or password' without field specification

negative_cases.title: Login with very long email
steps: Enter extremely long email (e.g., verylongemailaddress...(254+ characters)@example.com)
negative_cases.expected: Generic error message displayed. Email length validation is enforced

negative_cases.title: Login with password containing only spaces
negative_cases.expected: Generic error message displayed: 'Invalid email or password' without field specification

negative_cases.title: Brute force attack - attempt 100 logins
steps: Attempt login with invalid credentials 100 times automatically
negative_cases.expected: Account is locked after 5 attempts. Subsequent attempts are rejected immediately. No rate-limiting bypass
